profile.headline: Control Software Developer Sr. at Walt Disney Imagineering

positions.title: Control Software Developer Sr.
positions.description:
Project work has included:
- Star Wars: Galaxy’s Edge (DLR & DHS)
- Enchanted Tale of Beauty and the Beast (TDL)
- Mickey and Minnie’s Runaway Railway (DLR)
- Fantasy Springs: Anna and Elsa’s Frozen Journey (TDS)

volunteerExperiences.description: Oversaw the planning and execution of a STEM outreach event. The event brought in about 500+ low income and/or first generation students each year for a day of STEM lectures, workshops, and competitions. The goal of this event was to expose typically educationally disadvantaged students to STEM and the accessibility of attaining a higher education.

projects.title: UCSB Capstone - Infrared Image Capture System
projects.description: Created an interface for an Infrared Image Capturing System utilizing Qt with QML. The interface allowed users to create accounts, capture images, and review images from a desktop application. Used MySql within the Qt framework to store and retrieve user account information and images.
